payload.reason: The evidence provides specific reasons for the lower performance on Vikidia-FR compared to Newsela-ES, including differences in content diversity and the impact of ranking metrics due to the number of reading levels.

claims.text: Vikidia-FR has more diverse content compared to Newsela-ES, which has content from the same domain as Newsela-EN, potentially affecting performance.
Ranking metrics penalize Vikidia-FR more severely due to its limited number of reading levels, leading to lower SRC and KTCC scores compared to Newsela-ES.
An incorrect ranking in Vikidia-FR can result in a completely reversed list, which is heavily penalized, unlike in Newsela-ES.
